original_question.question: Twelve identical coins touch in a parallelogram with 3 rows of 4 coins, as shown. What is the smallest number of coins that must be moved to make the hollow hexagonal ring shown, with 3 coins along each side, counting each corner coin on both adjoining sides? In both arrangements, neighboring coins shown touching have centers one coin diameter apart. The coins may be lifted and placed freely, and a coin counts as moved if its center changes. The entire target arrangement may be translated and rotated, but not reflected or scaled; its position in the picture is only illustrative.
